hooks.command: python3 -c 'import json, sys, subprocess, os, shutil; data = json.load(sys.stdin); args = data.get("toolCall", {}).get("args", {}); path = args.get("Path") or args.get("TargetFile") or ""; ext = os.path.splitext(path)[1].lower(); subprocess.run(["ruff", "format", path], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL) if ext == ".py" and os.path.isfile(path) and shutil.which("ruff") else (subprocess.run(["npx", "--no-install", "prettier", "--write", path], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL) if ext in (".ts", ".tsx", ".js", ".jsx", ".css") and os.path.isfile(path) and shutil.which("npx") else None)' 2>/dev/null || true; printf '{}'
